jobs.description: Overview Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering. Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit. The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era. We have one product: new physics, at scale. Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact. Â Role and Responsibilities Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting. The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on. Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first. We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit. What We're Looking For A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials. Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list. You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently. A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically. Nice to Have Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security. Experience in research or scientific computing environments. Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem. Â How We Work We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage. Â Location and Compensation This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><h3>Your Impact</h3> <p>As a&nbsp;<strong>Senior Mechanical Engineer</strong>, you take technical ownership of mechanical systems and assemblies — from early concept and architecture through prototyping, qualification, and production. jobs.description: <div class="description content"> <p>We are looking for an Agentic AI Principal to act as a senior technical authority and trusted client advisor for complex agentic AI transformation in Germany, the Netherlands and the wider DACH region.</p> <p>Operating at Principal level, you will shape enterprise AI strategy, define agentic architecture blueprints, lead high-value C-suite engagements and guide complex programmes from opportunity through delivery. You will bring deep hands-on credibility in multi-agent systems, governance and safeguards, while setting reusable patterns and raising capability across teams.</p> <p>The role has particular focus on sovereign, compliant and production-grade agentic AI for regulated German, Dutch and European enterprises, with a primary focus on healthcare and life sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech and healthcare providers). Experience from other regulated sectors, such as financial services and insurance, automotive and manufacturing, energy and telecommunications, is equally welcome.</p> <p>Our delivery model is moving from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first, multidisciplinary pods accountable to a business outcome. You will anchor the agentic side of that work, pairing with our data, tech advisory and industry domain leads from presale through delivery.</p> <p>This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation.</p> </div> <h2 measurable business value and ROI.</li> <li>Represent Thoughtworks' agentic AI expertise in strategic client conversations, industry forums, partnerships and thought leadership where appropriate.</li> jobs.title: Solutions Manager- (German Fluency)
jobs.description: About Zip Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before. The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA. Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups. Your Role We’re looking a Solutions Manager with Finance / Procurement System experience (SAP) to lead onboarding for new customers and drive their implementation of our product. We’re also looking for someone who is excited to be hands on and influence our product roadmap. As every business needs our type of product, you’ll work with a variety of new clients and industries as Zip scales. Current clients include Coinbase, Snowflake, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Databricks. You Will Lead project teams onboarding new customers, with a heavy emphasis on project / stakeholder management and understanding client requirements Responsible for leading the end-to-end implementation for new customers -- roll up your sleeves and build out the customer’s processes from scratch Proactive project management across many customers, to manage requirements and tasks across onboardings Lead, mentor and train training and Q&A sessions with customers and key stakeholders to empower them to utilize the product without additional ongoing help from Zip Collaborate closely with the product and engineering teams to determine which customer requests we should and shouldn’t support, and set expectations with customers Do whatever it takes to make customers happy + successfully onboard them as quickly as possible Continuously improve the post-sales processes to help our customers accelerate the time to value Qualifications 8-10 years of experience implementing or administering a finance / procurement tool Prior experience with the implementation or administration of a procurement tool / ERP (SAP S/4HANA: procurement and AP, SAP Ariba Buying / Invoicing) Germany fluency required Fantastic communication and documentation skills Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive Very strong data management skills, specifically with handling large sets of sensitive customer data in MS Excel You’re able to push back and still make people happy Very comfortable with software configuration (not necessarily technical skills, which would be a plus) We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance.  We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation.    Who we're looking for:     As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Project Managers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you!  This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.     The role:     Lead the planning and implementation of software projects related to system connections with our customers, ensuring they are delivered on time and within scope.  Maintain and update project plans, proactively identifying and managing any project risks.  Ensure the availability of the right expertise for each project phase, coordinating with internal and external resources as necessary.  Manage stakeholder expectations, delivering regular and comprehensive project updates and effectively resolving any arising issues.  Contribute to the standardization of project implementation methodology and project templates to improve project standardization and efficiency.  Generate thorough Project/Solution Documentation, outlining project goals, deliverables, and timelines.  Handle all customer communication across various projects, ensuring clear, consistent, and timely communication with all stakeholders.  Master's degree in project management or related technical field required.  Background in Electronics/Electricals Professional Project Management Certification from an accredited institution preferred.  Demonstrated understanding of Project Management processes, strategies, and methods  Excellent time management and organizational skills and experience establishing guidelines in these areas for others.  3+ years of Project management experience in the field of software implementations  Experience with complex data projects where a systematic approach is crucial to success.  Dexterity with software tools and data manipulation & analysis  A creative mind that can think outside the box.  Curiosity to find disruptive as opposed to incremental solutions to challenging data problems.  Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU.    What We Offer:     Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value.  30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance.  Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent)

You'll lead the implementation and operationalisation of corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and indirect tax strategy, and you'll help shape the positions and policies behind it. You'll bring your own judgement to the most important topics, from how Pillar Two, CbCR, and ATAD III affect our structure to how we manage tax risk in audits, and you'll help the Head of Tax turn those views into a clear Group direction. This role reports to the Global Head of Tax and will have an impact on SumUp's IPO readiness. What you'll do Lead delivery of SumUp's tax agenda across corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and indirect tax, within the Group tax strategy set by the Head of Tax Oversee the transfer pricing framework and its implementation, and propose improvements to both substance and automation Draft and maintain tax policies, controls, and governance documentation for Group entities, for sign-off by the Head of Tax Act as the first point of contact for tax authority audits and controversies, keeping the Head of Tax aligned on positions and exposure Provide independent technical judgement on high-stakes tax positions, challenging assumptions and bringing options and recommendations to the Head of Tax Partner with Tax Compliance and Tax Operations to keep strategic positions compliant and operationally workable Lead the Pillar Two and CbCR implementation, turning requirements into practical plans for affected markets Lead, develop, and prioritise the tax team, and deputise for the Head of Tax when required You'll be great for this role if… Senior tax experience across corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and indirect tax in a multinational, combining strategic leadership with hands-on technical delivery. You're comfortable working through the detail yourself, from modelling and documentation to reviewing returns, and you don't need to hand every technical question to an adviser. A track record of building in-house tax expertise, with a preference for developing capability internally and using external advisers selectively, for specialist opinions and peer review rather than day-to-day analysis. Proven track record developing senior tax team members, including people leadership, prioritisation, and performance development. Strong knowledge of European corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and cross-border structuring, along with Pillar Two, CbCR, and EU Directives. Experience leading tax audits and controversies, including extensive direct engagement with tax authorities. Ability to translate complex regulatory and commercial issues into clear tax positions, communicated confidently to non-tax stakeholders such as finance leadership and auditors. Why you should join SumUp 🌎 Join a global fintech with meaningful complexity, scale, and ambition, and play a visible role in shaping the future of tax at SumUp 🚀 Work on high-impact topics including corporate tax, transfer pricing, structuring, controversy, governance, and international expansion 🤝 Act as a true business partner, helping shape how tax supports product, commercial, and strategic decisions across the company 🌈 Be part of a collaborative and inclusive environment where different perspectives are welcomed and valued 📚 Access opportunities for continuous learning and professional development About SumUp Be empowered to do more that matters. jobs.title: International Expansion
jobs.description: About Us At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the German market. Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen. This role will assess Axle’s participation in German markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace. You speak German and fluent English. Other European languages are also be an asset. What you will be doing Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue High-level strategy development, defining and executing Axle’s international expansion plans, and assessing the commercial value of German markets and business models Diving deep into policy and regulations, understanding how market access works and what needs doing to achieve it Developing the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships with key stakeholders. You’ll be jumping on the phone (and eventually, getting on the ground) with grid operators, utilities/retailers and potential clients to create and disprove hypotheses as quickly as possible. Acting as a conduit between partners and engineering teams creating fast, structured feedback loops that help translate field insights into meaningful product enhancements As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets. You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments. This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification. What’s in it for you This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience. We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. You’ll be based in the Germany. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. Interview process Initial interview Take-home exercise Final interview (in-person) Offer, references, and welcome to the team! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

In this role, you will work on cutting-edge systems—managing a diverse ecosystem of both container-orchestrated workloads on Kubernetes and event-driven serverless functions—to build robust microservices that handle complex, high-throughput data streams at scale. We are looking for Community Leads who are active in these language communities to help connect speakers with paid recording and transcription work. You'll act as a key operational point of contact for the account, coordinating linguists, DTP and video specialists, and internal stakeholders to hit release-critical deadlines. Coordinate subtitling, voiceover (AI and human) and video localization for trailers, cinematics and other video assets, including timing, rendering, editing and final QC of localized video files. Oversee desktop publishing (DTP) workflows for localized packaging, manuals and marketing collateral, working with DTP specialists to maintain layout fidelity across languages. Manage content intake, review cycles and publishing workflows in coordination with the customer's content and web teams. Use LILT-proprietary AI localization tools and build/maintain customer-specific translation memories and termbases to maintain consistency and leverage across projects. Support other project managers on the account, sharing best practice on production workflows and quality standards. What You'll Bring Proven experience as a project manager in the localization industry, with direct experience delivering programs for a game publisher or games customer. Strong working knowledge of AEM, Workfront and Jira (or directly comparable content, work-management and issue-tracking tools). Practical experience with AI localization tools and translation memory / terminology management. Experience managing high-volume, high-stakes customer accounts, with excellent stakeholder management across internal teams, linguists and customer contacts. Comfort with budget tracking and vendor/linguist management as part of day-to-day delivery. Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple concurrent, deadline-driven workstreams. Dann begleite Arztpraxen beim Wechsel auf eine neue Software – vom ersten Planungsgespräch bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live. DOMUS Consult sucht für einen Anbieter cloudbasierter Praxisverwaltungssoftware im Raum Berlin einen Onboarding Manager (m/w/d) . Im Customer Onboarding verbindest du Projektmanagement, Technik und persönlichen Kundenkontakt. Dein Ziel: Software Onboarding für Arztpraxen so gestalten, dass Praxisteams gut vorbereitet mit ihrem neuen System arbeiten können. Du machst aus einem Softwarewechsel einen guten Start Du steuerst das gesamte Onboarding von der Vertragsunterschrift bis zum Go-live und der anschließenden Übergabe an den Kundenservice. Du lernst die Abläufe und Anforderungen der Praxen kennen und konfigurierst das Praxisverwaltungssystem entsprechend. Du koordinierst die Datenmigration gemeinsam mit dem internen Datenmigrationsteam. Du schulst Ärztinnen, Ärzte, Medizinische Fachangestellte und das Praxismanagement – verständlich und passend zum jeweiligen Wissensstand. Du bringst alle Beteiligten zusammen: Praxisteams, Labore, externe IT-Dienstleister und Anbieter der Telematikinfrastruktur. Du bleibst die zentrale Ansprechperson für deine Praxen und gibst Feedback sowie eigene Verbesserungsideen an Produktmanagement und Entwicklung weiter. Du kannst erklären, organisieren und mitdenken Du bringst mindestens ein Jahr Erfahrung im Projektmanagement oder mindestens drei Jahre im Customer Service beziehungsweise Customer Success im IT- oder Softwareumfeld mit. Dabei verbindest du Kundenkontakt, Softwareimplementierung und Kundenschulung. Deine Erfahrungen aus den Projekten fließen in bessere Abläufe und die Weiterentwicklung des Produkts ein. About the Role We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering . Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it. You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations , lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter. This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace. The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV. What You'll Do Own the strategy and the stack Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together. Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself. Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams. Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback. Build, hands-on Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production. Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together. Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship. Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules. Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work. Humans and agents We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's. Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives. This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that. About the role Our largest customers do not buy Plane off the shelf. You will own the technical architecture for these deployments before the contract is signed and after, translating what a customer's infrastructure and compliance team requires into a Plane deployment that actually holds up. You will work directly with sales on the largest deals we run and with engineering when a customer's requirements push past what we support today. This role exists because our regulated-industry customers ask questions our sales team cannot answer alone, and our engineers should not have to answer on every call. Design self-hosted and air-gapped Plane deployments that satisfy a specific customer's security review, not a generic best-practice checklist. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together. Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship. Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules. Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work. Humans and agents We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's. Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives. This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that. About the role Plane has over a million users, and Fortune 500 companies deploying Plane. Enterprises in aerospace, defense, healthcare, and finance are running Plane in production — some in air-gapped, classified environments. The commercial demand is real and growing. This role exists to own it. You'll run full-cycle enterprise deals from first conversation to signed contract. You'll work directly with the CEO and the product team, because at this stage, a deal isn't just a sales process — it's a product feedback loop. You'll sell into technical buyers who already know the product, navigate complex procurement in regulated industries, and help build the playbook as you go. Plane's sales motion is product-led. The funnel doesn't start with cold outreach — it starts with teams already using Plane and hitting a ceiling where they need enterprise capabilities: compliance, SSO, air-gapped deployment, priority support. Your job is to convert that organic interest into expanding enterprise revenue. What you'll do Run deals end-to-end — from first enterprise inquiry to signed contract. jobs.title: Data Engineer – Healthcare
jobs.description: About PAICON PAICON is a Heidelberg-based health data intelligence company building the global health data foundation through its PaiX ecosystem, working to close the representation gap in medical data so personalised medicine works for everyone. We harmonise ethically approved, GDPR compliant real-world health data from providers around the world into a global dataset. The data covers multiple modalities on various disease entities. Our flagship product, PaiX Navigator, generates actionable insights for pharma, biotech and AI companies worldwide. The role We are looking for a hands-on data engineer to integrate data from our global partners into our platform. Data integration is the core of the role, and agentic AI tooling is part of how we do it. This is an on-site position in our Heidelberg office. You will work closely with medical, engineering and commercialization colleagues in a small, pragmatic team with short decision paths and direct access to the founders. What you'll do Onboard new data partners, from first assessment of their data through to reliable production ingestion Map partner data to our internal data model and work with providers to close gaps Build and maintain robust, well-tested data pipelines Ensure high standards in data quality and help evolve our database and data infrastructure Document data and transformations so that every step is transparent and traceable Ensure data is handled securely, de-identified and in line with healthcare data regulations Help us apply AI-assisted methods to data integration, with appropriate quality checks What you bring Several years of hands-on data engineering, including building and running production data pipelines Strong SQL and relational database design skills R and Python skills on Linux systems Familiarity with healthcare data standards such as HL7 FHIR and common clinical coding systems Understanding of data privacy and security in a regulated environment, including GDPR Day-to-day use of AI-assisted development tools and curiosity to go further with them A pragmatic mindset: you choose the simplest solution that works Ability to turn messy, real-world data into clear findings and next steps Good communication with technical and non-technical colleagues Independent, hands-on working style with agile mindset Fluent English, our primary working language Nice-to-have skills Experience with genomics/clinical & pathology data/digital histopathology data Experience with graph databases or ontologies Experience with containers, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure on hyperscalers. What you get from joining PAICON Hybrid working, with core office days to help organise how you do your best work An inclusive team where different backgrounds and perspectives are part of the point A friendly, motivated and agile environment where things move quickly and you see the impact of your work Flat hierarchies and short decision paths, with direct access to founders and medical, engineering and commercial colleagues Real ownership of your ideas: propose something good and you will be the one building it You will join a team solving a problem that matters, in a company where your voice carries weight from day one. There are no long approval chains between a good idea and a production system, and no layers between you and the people who depend on the data you integrate. If you want to shape how global health data is built rather than inherit someone else’s architecture, this is the place to do it! Cheers! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Global Trade Compliance Senior Specialist
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. jobs.title: Release Manager - AI Models
jobs.description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams Our engineering teams bring together ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product to turn breakthrough autonomous-driving technology into reliable products. Model releases connect these disciplines, taking AI models from early hypotheses through training, evaluation, and on-road testing to deployment across our vehicle fleet. As our Release Manager — AI Models, you’ll help ensure that a core part of our technology — the AI model — is released reliably, on time, and to the standard required for production. You’ll bring structure and disciplined release practices to the fast-paced, non-deterministic world of ML, building the processes and systems that support clarity, stability, and business goals. 🧠 Your day-to-day Own the model release cycle, maintaining a steady and predictable cadence while adapting to changing business priorities. Coordinate across ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product to keep releases moving and resolve dependencies. Run the gates that promote models from hypothesis → training → evaluation → validation → deployment, making clear what is ready to ship and what needs more work. Drive investigations into regressions and integration issues, coordinate rollback or roll-forward decisions, and follow through on technical debt and corrective actions. Be the central point of contact for model-release status, risks, and timelines, giving engineers and leadership the right level of detail. Run post-release reviews and turn lessons learned into practical improvements across teams. 🧩 What you’ll be working on: Release gates and promotion criteria: Define and justify what it takes for a model to progress, balancing performance gains, reproducibility, product requirements, safety, and compatibility with the onboard software stack and vehicle platform. A release process that works for ML: Build frameworks that connect model development, evaluation, the Wayve onboard stack, and product needs — applying strong release-engineering practices while recognising where hypothesis-driven, non-deterministic systems need a different approach. Bottleneck identification and improvement: Find constraints in the release lifecycle, implement dashboards and KPIs to make them visible, and proactively escalate gaps. Tooling and automation: Partner with ML platform and integration teams to shape end-to-end automated release tooling. Define requirements that improve developer experience, release efficiency, and stakeholder communication. Reliable, stable deployments: Strengthen how teams handle model versions, integration issues, regressions, and recovery so that releases deliver value reliably. 🙌 You should apply if: You have 5+ years of experience in release management, software engineering, or a related field. You understand the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and release management practices, including testing strategy, system integration, branching, and versioning. You have a conceptual understanding of ML fundamentals: what training data is, the difference between training and inference, what a model version or checkpoint represents, and why model validation is probabilistic rather than simply pass/fail. You have experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools such as GitHub, Buildkite, and CLI tools. You’re skilled at managing releases in complex, fast-moving systems and comfortable adapting processes and tooling as requirements, architecture, and timelines change. jobs.description: Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle. At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth. We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary. Principal Engineer, Data Quality Platform You'll own data correctness across Talos. You'll lead the data quality engineering team, run BAU data operations, and own reference and security master data, along with the pipelines and platform that deliver it. Our goal: the data we return to clients is always correct, and we find defects before a client does. You'll join a small team with the mandate to work independently from product engineering and challenge it. Engineering teams make assumptions about how their systems behave. Your job is to test those assumptions and prove or disprove them with evidence. Responsibilities Lead AI-first data quality engineering Validate every client-facing endpoint continuously. The focus is our REST and WebSocket APIs. Cloud delivery (S3, Snowflake, Databricks) is also in scope. Assert correctness against independent sources of truth, across every environment and client entitlement. Cover streaming as well as request/response. For WebSocket, that means: sequencing and gap detection snapshot-to-increment consistency reconnect and replay correctness staleness of live subscriptions agreement between the streamed view and the REST view of the same state Use adaptive detection, not static thresholds. Learn baselines per endpoint and per market, and let them adjust as "normal" changes. Hand-set limits get noisy, go stale, and teach people to ignore alerts. Apply LLM and agentic tooling to generate checks from API specs and schemas, keep them current as the product changes, and triage alerts before a human sees them. Know when a deterministic rule, invariant or cross-source reconciliation is the better tool. Test resilience and load. Design load, performance and failure-mode tests. When you find a fault, raise it with the owning team with enough evidence for them to act. Drive it to resolution, then add a check that would have caught it earlier. Measure and publish endpoint and field coverage, time to detect, detected-before-client rate and false-positive rate. Run data governance Build and maintain a catalog of our data assets and APIs, covering lineage and downstream consumers. Maintain an understanding of assets, how they're used and what breaks when they change. Own data governance tooling such as OpenMetadata. Own reference and security master data Lead the build-out of the next-generation security master platform, then run it day to day: new listings, symbol mapping across venues, and increment and contract specs. Design processes for safe updates to security entries, with validation and rollback. Expand coverage across the firm Over time, extend data quality coverage beyond client APIs to: trade signals pre-trade analytics client post-trade analysis PMS analytics Qualifications A track record of leading data QA or data quality teams, preferably on market data or other high-throug

jobs.description: <h2>About the job</h2> <p>Expose manufacturing defects in Graphcore’s advanced circuit boards with tests you build and deploy.</p> <p>Based in Bristol, UK, you’ll develop board and PCBA hardware tests that help turn complex designs into reliable products. You’ll take tests from initial design analysis to deployment, then support them in factories and the field.</p> <p>Better defect coverage means more opportunities to identify manufacturing problems and understand hardware failures when products are in use. You’ll help make test and inspection methods work together, targeting the ways advanced electronic assemblies can go wrong.</p> <p>You’ll examine PCB testability and susceptibility to manufacturing defects, then use that analysis to define and develop test solutions. You’ll build boundary scan and embedded functional tests, turning your understanding of board behaviour into practical diagnostic tools.</p> <h2>The team and culture</h2> <p>The Product Test and Diagnosis team tackles hardware defects across chips, boards and finished systems. You’ll work directly with Hardware Design, Manufacturing Operations and contract electronics manufacturers, connecting design knowledge with factory experience.</p> <p>Use evidence to guide test decisions, challenge gaps in coverage and take responsibility for moving improvements forward. Move quickly from diagnosis to action, bringing the right people together to resolve hardware problems.</p> <h2>What we're looking for</h2> <ul> <li>Strong electronics fundamentals, particularly digital electronics.</li> <li>Commercial experience in board or PCBA hardware testing.</li> <li>Understanding of manufacturing test for advanced electronic systems.</li> <li>Knowledge of surface-mount technology (SMT), PCB manufacturing processes and their failure mechanisms.</li> <li>Understanding of automated optical inspection (AOI) and automated X-ray inspection (AXI) capabilities.</li> <li>Ability to diagnose electronic defects to component level.</li> </ul> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. jobs.title: Senior CRM Executive
jobs.description: Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were. About the role Every product launch, promo and market entry at LemFi reaches customers through a campaign. As Senior CRM Executive, you'll build and ship them: email, push, in-app and SMS, across remittance, credit, savings and whatever we launch next. You take a brief and turn it into a live, tested, correctly targeted send - then tell us what it did. You'll report to the Senior CRM Manager for Campaigns and work daily with Growth Managers, Product Marketing, Design and Compliance. This is a hands-on role with a high volume of sends and a high bar for getting each one right, because a wrong rate, a broken link or the wrong segment lands in a customer's pocket. Do it well and you'll be the person the rest of the business trusts to get their message out. What you'll build and own Build and launch campaigns end to end in our marketing automation platform: segments, content, scheduling and send. Turn campaign requests from across the business into clear builds, and push back when a brief doesn't hold up. QA every send before it goes: targeting, personalisation, links, localisation and compliance sign-off. Run A/B tests on subject lines, timing, offers and channels, and feed what wins into the next campaign. Keep the campaign calendar honest so customers aren't hit by five messages in one day. Report on every campaign in numbers the team can act on: who received it, who converted, what it was worth. Spot what's repetitive in your own work and template or automate it. Your experience 1-3 years in CRM, email marketing or lifecycle, ideally in fintech, e-commerce or another high-frequency consumer product. Hands-on with a marketing automation platform ( Customer.io , Braze, Iterable or similar) - you build the campaign yourself. Working knowledge of Liquid and HTML for personalised, dynamic content. An eye for detail that catches the wrong segment or the broken link before the customer does. Comfortable pulling your own numbers, with basic SQL or a BI tool such as Tableau, Looker, Amplitude or Mixpanel. Bias to ship: you'd rather launch, measure and iterate than polish a brief. Comfortable using AI tools to speed up copy variants, translations and QA checks. Nice to have Lived experience or deep empathy with the life of our users - the millions who move countries to build something better. Language skills in Italian, Portuguese, German, Mandarin, Wolof or Swahili. Experience running campaigns in a regulated or compliance-sensitive comms environment. Why Join LemFi? Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down. Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play . We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee. jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to join our Marketing Operations, RevOps team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help build the operational infrastructure needed to support our upmarket expansion into Mid-Market and Enterprise segments and be part of our Marketing Ops team as we scale our spend management platform across growth companies in Europe. If you're excited about designing account-based go-to-market systems, establishing AI enablement across operational workflows, and solving complex cross-functional challenges, and are passionate about marketing operations, RevOps, and systems architecture, then this is the opportunity for you! Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Associate Director, Marketing Operations and work closely with teams in Marketing Operations, RevOps, and Sales Ops. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to powering how the marketing team runs—from campaign operations and reporting cadence through to AI adoption and process improvement. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Data, BAT (Business Automation & Tools), CX Ops, and Engineering to ensure success and maintain a single account truth across systems. What you’ll be doing As a Marketing Operations Manager, you will: Build and refine marketing operational frameworks – Lead initiatives to continuously improve campaign workflows, request intake, approval processes, team governance, MQL→MQA routing logic, and SDR/BDR handoff processes. Own account intelligence and reporting cadence – Design account scoring models for Mid-Market and Enterprise, maintain executive dashboards, integrate intent/firmographic/behavioral signals into segmentation, and manage account assignment logic. Drive AI adoption across Marketing Ops – Translate AI capabilities into operational reality by building processes, governance, and enablement that accelerate execution and scale output within the team. Ensure tooling health and systems ownership – Manage HubSpot workflows, automations, and integrations while coordinating with BAT and Engineering on tech stack builds, QA standards, and enterprise tooling requirements. Enable team capabilities and documentation habits – Upskill Marketing and Marketing Ops teammates through shared standards, QA checklists, repeatable guides, templates, and onboarding resources to raise the operational floor. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: HubSpot Fluency – A solid understanding of designing workflows, routing logic, and automation in HubSpot, including its limitations and when to extend outside the platform. Account Operations Mindset – Track record of building ABM operational processes, MQL-to-MQA scoring rules, multi-stakeholder buying committee motions, and AI/automation adoption that sticks. Sales Ops

jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en problèmes publics des centres de données pour rejoindre le département de recherche Sciences Économiques et Sociales (SES) et plus particulièrement la chaire SHS TerraAINs. Contexte scientifique : La Chaire SHS TerrAINs s’intéresse aux enjeux territoriaux du développement des infrastructures numériques et plus particulièrement des centres de données en France. Elle est portée par Pauline Gourlet et financée par la Région Ile de France (2026-2029). Longtemps demeurés une infrastructure invisible, les centres de données ( data centers ) se trouvent désormais au cœur des problématiques des politiques publiques et industrielles et la Région Ile de France concentre aujourd’hui ces infrastructures (plus de 165 en 2024), avec de nombreux projets de data centers hyperscale à l’étude. Vecteurs d’innovation, objets de spéculation, instruments de réaffirmation de puissance nationale, leur développement rapide génère aussi de nombreuses inquiétudes, voire du rejet, en France (comme à l’étranger), et ne fait pas à ce jour l’objet d’une planification concertée, mais relève encore largement d’opportunités isolées. Or, ces projets d’infrastructure se trouvent à la croisée d’enjeux locaux, voire hyper-locaux — de l’aménagement territorial aux effets sur l’environnement — et d’enjeux nationaux et internationaux — de la tension sur les réseaux d’électricité aux questions de souveraineté technologique et d’investissement. Au sein de la Chaire, le ou la post-doctorant(e) étudiera la manière dont les centres de données, objets clés de l’infrastructure numérique, se développent et organisent différents problèmes publics relatifs aux « territoires » à différentes échelles territoriales. Comment en retour, la définition et la hiérarchisation de ces problèmes peuvent permettent des arbitrages concertés pour planifier leur déploiement ? Les modalités de participation à la construction de ces problèmes publics, autant que la fabrique des données nécessaires pour nourrir les positions des acteurs, sont autant un enjeu de démocratie technique qu’une manière de retrouver prise sur l’aménagement des milieux de vie. En articulant sociologie des sciences et des techniques et études urbaines avec une méthodologie innovante de recherche-action , TerrAINs contribue à rendre visibles et discutables les infrastructures numériques, tout en expérimentant des outils de représentation des problèmes et de participation, adaptées aux enjeux infrastructurels contemporains. La Chaire est organisée selon trois axes principaux : Analyse des discours sur les centres de données, et notamment les discours médiatiques régionaux, nationaux et étrangers ; Description des modalités du « faire infrastructure » : pratiques situées, relations aux milieux, frictions. Cet axe investira trois sites franciliens concernés par des projets de centres hyperscale. la chaire est conçue comme un laboratoire de recherche-action qui expérimente de nouvelles modalités de représentation et de participation autour des infrastructures numériques. Vos missions principales seront de : Assurer des missions de recherche dans le cadre de la Chaire Terrains Participer à l’animation de la chaire et contribuer aux projets menés par les autres membres de l’équipe Participer à des actions de valorisation des travaux menés au sein de la chaire Assurer des missions d’encadrement (stagiaires, workshops étudiant) Consulter la description des missions complètes dans la fiche de poste détaillée. jobs.description: Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation. Dans le cadre du projet ANR-DFG 3DFaceBias , qui vise à mesurer, expliquer et réduire les écarts de précision dans la reconstruction faciale 3D à partir de photographies 2D, nous recrutons un Post-doctorat en évaluation et réduction des biais en reconstruction faciale 3D au sein de notre département Data Science sur le campus de Brest. Vous piloterez les travaux d’IMT Atlantique sur l’évaluation et la réduction des biais en reconstruction faciale 3D avec pour principales missions : Auditer les biais de la reconstruction faciale 3D à partir d'images 2D. Identifier les sources de biais par une analyse centrée sur les données. Concevoir et évaluer des stratégies centrées sur les données pour atténuer les biais. Contribuer aux activités transverses du projet. Consultez la fiche de poste détaillée ✔️ Vous avez une solide expérience en recherche expérimentale et en méthodes statistiques avancées. Votre expertise inclut la conception d’expériences contrôlées, l’évaluation des incertitudes, la gestion des facteurs de confusion, ainsi que la prévention des fuites d’information (data leakage). ✔️ Maîtrisant Python et un framework comme PyTorch, vous savez modifier, tester et déboguer du code de recherche avec efficacité. Vos compétences couvrent des domaines clés tels que : Vision par ordinateur, reconstruction 3D et géométrie 3D, Modèles statistiques de forme ou informatique médicale, Équité algorithmique, robustesse, généralisation et génération de données synthétiques. ✔️ Vous excellez dans l’évaluation des performances et des biais, via des analyses par sous-groupes, l’interprétation des disparités et un examen rigoureux des limites. Une expérience en reconstruction faciale 3D serait un atout. ✔️ Autonome et proactif·ve, vous formulez des hypothèses pertinentes et hiérarchisez les expériences avec méthode. ✔️ Rigoureux·se, vous garantissez la reproductibilité de vos travaux, une documentation claire et une gestion collaborative du code et des données. ✔️ Ouvert·e au travail en équipe 🇬🇧 À l’aise en anglais scientifique, vous rédigez avec clarté et précision, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. 🎓 Le profil recherché devra être titulaire d’un Doctorat (obtenu moins de 3 ans avant la date d’embauche) en apprentissage automatique, informatique, statistiques, mathématiques appliquées, informatique appliquée à l’imagerie médicale ou dans un domaine connexe, obtenu avant la prise de poste. POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE : 🚀 Piloter des travaux de recherche au sein d’un projet international consacré à la fiabilité et à l’équité des méthodes de reconstruction 3D. 🤝 Travailler à l’interface de l’apprentissage automatique, des statistiques et de l’informatique appliquée à l’imagerie médicale. 🌍Développer vos recherches expérimentales et vos publications au sein d’une collaboration franco-allemande aux expertises complémentaires. 🍃 Faire progresser une recherche responsable et reproductible grâce à une évaluation transparente, à une gestion rigoureuse des données faciales et à des méthodes et du code réutilisables, partagés chaque fois que les autorisations le permettent. jobs.title: ICT System Engineer & Developer 80-100 %
jobs.description: Du liebst die Abwechslung und willst Dich nicht zwischen Systembetrieb und Softwareentwicklung entscheiden müssen? Bei uns kannst Du beides! Wir suchen eine strukturierte Persönlichkeit, die unsere IT-Infrastruktur im Griff hat und gleichzeitig neue Softwarelösungen mitgestaltet. Wir wachsen und verstärken deshalb unser vierköpfiges ICT-Team per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung mit einem neuen Teammitglied im Pensum von 80 bis 100 %. Gemeinsam betreuen wir die IT unserer Firmengruppe mit mehreren Mandanten, mit über 100 Benutzerinnen und Benutzern an mehreren Standorten. Ob Dein Fundament in der Systemtechnik oder in der Applikationsentwicklung liegt: Wenn Du für moderne Technologien brennst, wollen wir Dich im Team haben. Aufgaben ICT Operation & Netzwerke Du stellst den stabilen Betrieb der IT-Umgebungen unserer gesamten Firmengruppe sicher, insbesondere Windows Server und Clients, Virtualisierung sowie Managed Security Services. Du betreust unsere Microsoft SQL Server und die dazugehörigen Datenbanken und sorgst für deren Verfügbarkeit und Performance. Du betreust unser internes Netzwerk, überwachst es aktiv und schützt unsere Netzwerkinfrastruktur mit geeigneten Tools und Firewalls. Du überwachst den operativen Betrieb proaktiv mit modernen Monitoring-Tools und behebst Störungen frühzeitig. Du verwaltest selbstständig die Benutzerberechtigungen im Active Directory und in Microsoft 365 und betreust gemeinsam mit unserem Partner unsere 3CX-Telefonielösung. Software & Innovation Du unterstützt das Team bei der Entwicklung, Implementierung und Wartung unserer internen Applikationen und Schnittstellen. Du nimmst Anforderungen aus den Fachabteilungen auf und setzt sie in pragmatische technische Lösungen um. Du testest moderne KI-Tools und integrierst sie, um interne Prozesse einfacher und effizienter zu gestalten. Support & Teamwork Du arbeitest im First- und Second-Level-Support mit und beantwortest die Fragen unserer Mitarbeitenden kompetent und hilfsbereit. Qualifikation Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Informatikerin oder Informatiker EFZ mit Schwerpunkt Systemtechnik oder Applikationsentwicklung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit fundierter Berufserfahrung. Fundierte Erfahrung im Betrieb von Windows Server- und Client-Umgebungen. Kenntnisse in Proxmox VE (PVE) sind ein Plus. Ein gutes Grundverständnis für Netzwerke und Firewalls sowie ein ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsbewusstsein. Erste Erfahrungen in der Softwareentwicklung mit C# im .NET-Umfeld und JavaScript sowie Freude daran, dieses Wissen zu vertiefen. Routine mit PowerShell oder anderen Skriptsprachen, um Aufgaben und administrative Prozesse zu automatisieren. Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. Du packst Aufgaben proaktiv an. Grosses Interesse an neuen Technologien und Lust, das Potenzial von KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag auszuloten. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse zum Verstehen von Fachliteratur und Dokumentationen. Benefits Eine abwechslungsreiche Generalistenrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum in einem wachsenden Unternehmen. Ein kleines, kollegiales Team mit kurzen Wegen und schnellen Entscheiden. Eine pragmatische Kultur, in der neugierige Ideen willkommen sind und KI-Tools aktiv eingesetzt werden. 5 Wochen Ferien. Jedes dritte Jahr eine zusätzliche Ferienwoche oder deren Auszahlung. Zeiterfassung mit der Möglichkeit, Überstunden zu kompensieren oder auszahlen zu lassen. Die Möglichkeit für Homeoffice. Interessiert? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung! jobs.title: Robot Pilot
jobs.description: About nu glass The Robot Pilot is responsible for operating our laser robot technology on-site, ensuring strict adherence to production schedules, quality standards, and safety guidelines. Reporting to the Robotics Manufacturing and Support Engineer, this role plays a key part in troubleshooting issues and maintaining efficient, continuous operations within a collaborative team. Your responsibilities As a Robot Pilot at nu glass in Spiez, you will operate and manage robotic systems directly on-site as part of a 45-hour workweek on a 12-month fixed-term contract starting January 11, 2027. What we are looking for We are looking for someone ready to take on the operation of our specialized laser ablation equipment within our agile team. Open to working 4 nights/week German and English speaker Willing to travel in Germany and within Switzerland ( at our cost) Your first months at nu glass You will quickly get hands-on with state-of-the-art laser technology, integrating into our daily operations and contributing to projects that enhance connectivity and sustainability. If you match most of our requirements, we encourage you to apply. Benefits Flexible working hours Compensation CHF 60,000–64,800 per year Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager - Paid Social (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About Hilo by Aktiia High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.  We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.  We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship. Role overview As Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Social , you will own Hilo’s paid social strategy and performance across our key markets and prepare the channel for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market. jobs.description: Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day. As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you. You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together. You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date. You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence. You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law. You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter. You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like. You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years. Strong experience in agentic AI. You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries. You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses. You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough. You have measured the quality of an LLM system with evaluation sets or observability, and can give a concrete example. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus. You have back-end experience, including building REST APIs. You have experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Postgres is useful. Experience in a legal, tax or other knowledge-intensive domain is a plus. WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. Dit maakt jou succesvol in deze rol  Jij past perfect bij de pioniersgeest van onze organisatie. Dit betekent dat je niet bang bent om buiten de lijntjes te kleuren, initiatief te nemen en daardoor dus graag aan de slag gaat met nieuwe inzichten en projecten. Daarnaast ben je analytisch sterk, werk je graag zelfstandig en ben je van nature erg nieuwsgierig. Wat wij van jou verwachten: Je bent een Bachelor student in de richting Finance, Bedrijfseconomie of soortgelijk; Je bent beschikbaar voor een stageduur van een half jaar (startende in februari); Je hebt de gedrevenheid om een complexe uitdaging, zoals het meetbaar maken van R&D, aan te vliegen. Als Account Executive voor de Nederlandse markt ben jij de persoon die kansen omzet in betalende klanten. Je bedient de B2B-markt over de volle breedte: van horeca tot retail, van zorg tot transport. Bedrijven die vaak nog met Excel of een verouderd systeem werken en waarbij jij in één demo laat zien hoeveel tijd ze terugkrijgen. De use case is herkenbaar, de waarde is snel duidelijk en dat maakt je verkoopcycli lekker kort. Het grootste deel van je pipeline is warm. Je dag bestaat voor een groot deel uit bellen en demo's, want dit is een hands-on salesrol. Sporadisch ga je op pad naar een klant voor een persoonlijk gesprek. Je deelt wat voor jou werkt met het team, want we worden hier beter van elkaar. Wie ben jij? Denk aan omgevingen zoals Lightspeed, Zenchef of vergelijkbare SME-gerichte hospitality- of retailtech. Een rol waarin je een SaaS-oplossing verkoopt die bedrijven écht vooruit helpt, in een omgeving waar resultaat en plezier hand in hand gaan. Groei is hier geen loze belofte. We investeren serieus in je ontwikkeling vanaf dag één. Je start met een gedegen 30-60-90-dagen-onboardingprogramma met duidelijke milestones, zodat je precies weet waar je staat en waar je naartoe werkt. Je wordt daarnaast getraind en gecertificeerd via Winning by Design, hét toonaangevende salestrainingsprogramma voor SaaS, inclusief SPICED-certificering. Daarbovenop krijg je een persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 per jaar om te investeren in wat jou verder brengt: cursussen, conferenties, boeken of coaching. Jij kiest. Active, current use of AI in your own marketing workflow, for research, analysis, content variation, and speeding up execution, not just openness to using it. jobs.title: Founding Engineer (gn) – Hardware & Bioengineering, Munich
jobs.description: About Cellsor Cameras digitized vision. Microphones digitized sound. Smell is the one major sense we still can't capture, measure or transmit reliably. Cellsor is building the sensor that changes that. We replicate the mammalian olfactory epithelium outside the body – living olfactory tissue on microelectrode arrays – and read it out with machine learning. The result is a sensor that detects chemicals the way a nose does, with the breadth and sensitivity that conventional gas sensors lack. Applications span flavor and fragrance, defense and security, medical diagnostics, food quality and industrial monitoring. We are a VC-backed Tufts University spin-out with a working proof of principle and paid industry pilots, with teams in Boston (biology) and Munich (engineering). About the role As our first engineer in Munich, you develop the instrument that keeps our living sensor tissue alive and samples the air it analyzes. You take it from today's lab setup to a field-ready prototype at a customer site within 18 months. What you will do: Define the instrument architecture, then build prototypes across mechanics, fluidics and housing Develop automated media exchange that keeps cells viable for weeks to months Build the air path: sampling, filtration and controlled delivery of odorants to the sensor Integrate sensors, pumps and controllers for monitoring and automation Test and iterate with our Boston biology team Contribute to grant applications What you need to succeed Must-have: MSc or PhD in mechanical, biomedical or bioengineering, or a related field Built a lab or medical device from concept to working prototype CAD, rapid prototyping, and electronics integration Comfortable with uncertainty: you make progress without a defined path and decide what to build next Hands-on and self-directed – you'd rather test an idea on the bench than discuss it for a week Fluent English; German a plus Nice-to-have: Cell culture, perfusion or microfluidics Gas handling or air sampling Startup or grant-funded R&D experience Why join Cellsor now Cellsor is an early-stage, VC-backed deep-tech startup, funded to focus on building. Most hardware roles mean optimizing one part of an existing product. Here you build the first instrument for a new category of sensor, and your design decisions become the foundation of the platform. The technical risk has moved from "does this work?" to "how do we build it for the field?" – which is exactly where an engineer makes the difference. As the platform grows into electrode integration, machine learning and product design, so does the scope of your role. What we offer Equity in Cellsor, so you share in the value you help create The opportunity to build and lead the Munich engineering team as we grow Real responsibility from day one, working directly with the founders and technical advisors Lab and workspace at UnternehmerTUM, with regular exchange with our Boston team Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
